Pinia Colada import.description:
Import a Pinia Colada 1 API.

导入 Pinia Colada 1 API。

Pinia Colada plugin.description:
Install Pinia Colada on the application; it builds on Pinia, so Pinia must be installed first. Requires PiniaColada from @pinia/colada and createPinia from pinia.

在应用上安装 Pinia Colada；它建立在 Pinia 之上，须先安装 Pinia；需要 @pinia/colada 的 PiniaColada 与 pinia 的 createPinia。

Pinia Colada useQuery.description:
Read server state with Pinia Colada. Its options are named key and query, not queryKey and queryFn. Requires useQuery from @pinia/colada.

用 Pinia Colada 读取服务端状态；它的选项名为 key 与 query，而非 queryKey 与 queryFn；需要 @pinia/colada 的 useQuery。

Pinia Colada reactive key.description:
Make the key a getter so the query refetches when its input changes. Requires useQuery from @pinia/colada and ref from vue.

把 key 写成 getter，输入变化时查询即重新执行；需要 @pinia/colada 的 useQuery 与 vue 的 ref。

Pinia Colada defineQueryOptions.description:
Define reusable query options that a component can spread and override per call. Requires defineQueryOptions from @pinia/colada.

定义可复用的查询选项，组件可展开后按需覆盖其中的项；需要 @pinia/colada 的 defineQueryOptions。

Pinia Colada defineQuery.description:
Wrap a query in a composable so every caller shares one instance and any extra state around it. Requires defineQuery and useQuery from @pinia/colada.

把查询封装成组合式函数，所有调用方共用同一实例及其周边状态；需要 @pinia/colada 的 defineQuery 与 useQuery。

Pinia Colada useMutation.description:
Write to the server and invalidate what the change affects. Its option is named mutation, not mutationFn. Requires useMutation and useQueryCache from @pinia/colada.

向服务端写入并使受影响的查询失效；它的选项名为 mutation，而非 mutationFn；需要 @pinia/colada 的 useMutation 与 useQueryCache。

Pinia Colada optimistic mutation.description:
Apply a change before the server confirms it and roll back on failure; what onMutate returns is handed to the later hooks. Requires useMutation and useQueryCache from @pinia/colada.

在服务端确认前先行应用变更，失败时回滚；onMutate 的返回值会传给后续钩子；需要 @pinia/colada 的 useMutation 与 useQueryCache。

Pinia Colada invalidate queries.description:
Refetch a query and, unless exact is set, everything nested under its key. Requires useQueryCache from @pinia/colada, inside an async function.

重新拉取某个查询，未设置 exact 时连同其键下的所有子查询一并失效；需要 @pinia/colada 的 useQueryCache，且置于 async 函数内。
